sections_target.text: This document outlines the P2 major maintenance procedures, which must be carried out every two years on medium voltage distributors as indicated above by the code Y2. This document was prepared, reviewed and approved by the MPIS coordinators in the zones of the Egyptian Electricity Transmission Company, and this maintenance is carried out in accordance with the manufacturers' instructions and acquired experience, with the aim of avoiding sudden faults and raising the efficiency of the distribution boards' equipment.

rows: Issue an approved work order; the maintenance staff must hold the occupational safety and health category card
The work area must be fenced off and warning signs put in place
Safety and occupational health equipment must be worn
Ensure that the serviceable tools, instruments and devices and the spare parts used in the maintenance are available
Ensure that there is no voltage from the supply source, using the voltage indicator on the part to be worked on
Ensure that the cable disconnect switches are opened and isolated from all their sources
Ensure that a portable earth is applied to the equipment to be worked on
Ensure that the DC supply of the protection devices is isolated
Ensure that the cells are numbered and labelled from the front and the back
The occupational safety and health and protection officers must be present on site
Emergency lighting machine
Complete tool kit (socket set, screwdriver set, Allen key set, open-end wrench set, etc.)
Safety and occupational health equipment such as safety helmet, safety shoes, gloves, goggles, cotton coveralls with sleeves, etc.
Blower, portable earth, cleaning brushes and soft, clean cloth pieces
Suitable electrical grease, lubricating oil, paint material for coating, primer for painting
Earth resistance measuring device, avometer, tested voltage indicator, hydrometer
Torque wrench, spare lighting lamps, starter, transformers
Fire extinguisher and sensitive hose, insulating hoses for the phases
Numbering machine, first-aid kit

Ensure that the cable trenches are clean and the cables are correctly placed inside them, and ensure that the cable trenches have covers
Check that the cables are laid neatly in the trenches, the spacing between them, and the numbering and labelling of the cables
Ensure that there is no seepage water in the cable trenches
Ensure that the cable entry openings (shanayesh) are tightly closed
Check the cable end boxes and their earthing, and that there is no oil leakage from them for oil-filled boxes, if present
Test the cables using a 2500 V Megger to ensure that no phase is connected to earth, and note the similarity of the insulation of the three phases

sections_target.text: Ensure that the batteries and charger perform properly as follows:

rows: Check the connections between the battery poles and the charger and ensure that they are sound
Measure the distilled water level and top it up if necessary
Measure the density of the battery solution in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions
Measure the voltage of the battery poles in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions
Clean the external parts and the connection points of the batteries
Test the opening and closing of some switches on the batteries only, grease the battery terminals and replace them if necessary
Ensure that the battery room ventilation is sound and the exhaust fans are sound
Ensure that the batteries are isolated from earth

Inspect all openings in the board, especially the cable entry and exit openings, the windows and the doors, and ensure that the glass and the ventilation wire are sound, to prevent birds, reptiles and insects from entering the distributor, and treat the groundwater if found in the distributor or alongside the cables
Ensure that the main earth of the board is connected
Check the general lighting of the distributor and the lighting of the board building on DC (emergency lighting)
Check the audible alarm device on the board
Ensure that the means of communication on the board (radio and telephone) perform properly

Ensure that the following records are present: daily loads record, operation record, board maintenance record, board faults record, work order record, protection devices record, battery maintenance record, board history record, visits record
Ensure that a single-line diagram of the cells is present, showing the numbers and names of the cells
Ensure that a key cabinet is present
Ensure that the fire extinguishers are sound and valid, that a visit card is present, and that the dates and the reviewer's signature are recorded on it
Ensure that a first-aid kit is present
Check the cleanliness of the distributor floors, walls and front after finishing them
Ensure that the distributor floor is sound

Introduction
This document outlines the P2 major maintenance procedures, which must be carried out every two years on medium voltage distributors as indicated above by the code Y2. This document was prepared, reviewed and approved by the MPIS coordinators in the zones of the Egyptian Electricity Transmission Company, and this maintenance is carried out in accordance with the manufacturers' instructions and acquired experience, with the aim of avoiding sudden faults and raising the efficiency of the distribution boards' equipment.
Safety Precautions
Tools and Equipment
Work to be Carried Out
First: Medium Voltage Circuit Breakers
Second: Medium Voltage Busbars
Third: Cables
Fourth: Batteries and Charger
Ensure that the batteries and charger perform properly as follows:
Fifth: Boards
Sixth: Transformer Maintenance
Transformers are maintained in accordance with the approved MPIS documents, in addition to measuring the insulation resistance of the transformer windings
